entries.title: Genesis 26:1
segments: Gerar; a city of the Philistines in the south part of Canaan.

entries.title: Genesis 26:5
segments: As great blessings often come upon children in consequence of the piety and faithfulness of parents, by the exercise of like piety and faithfulness children should endeavor to confer similar blessings on their posterity.

entries.title: Genesis 26:10
segments: The Bible describes men as they are; records not only their virtues but their vices, and often without commending the one or condemning the other.  Whether an action is right or wrong must be determined not from the fact of its being recorded in the Scriptures, but from its agreement or disagreement with the requirements of God.

entries.title: Genesis 26:12
segments: A hundred-fold; a hundred times as much as he had sowed.

entries.title: Genesis 26:14
segments: God deals with men in this world not according to their sins, but according to the greatness of his mercy; and every new blessing lays them under new obligations to love and obey him.

entries.title: Genesis 26:22
segments: Men who cannot live near each other without contention, had better separate and live further apart.  There is room enough for all; and let all do to others as they ought to wish that others should do to them, and all may live in peace.

entries.title: Genesis 26:26
segments: Went to him; to make with him a covenant of peace and friendship.

entries.title: Genesis 26:30
segments: He made them a feast; showing that he was willing to live in peace with them.

entries.title: Genesis 26:31
segments:
Sware to one another; entered into a solemn engagement with each other to live in peace. 
 
A wise man, when he has been injured, will not be disposed to take revenge, but will be ready to overlook and forgive past transgressions.

entries.title: Genesis 26:33
segments: Beer-sheba; Abraham had named the well Beer-sheba, well of the oath, from the oath between himself and Abimelech,
.  Now Isaac, from a like transaction, names the place also Beer-sheba.

entries.title: Genesis 26:34
segments: The Hittite; the Hittites were descendants of Heth the son of Canaan, and one of the nations that were afterwards to be destroyed.
